logic.description: Reworked 2026-10-29 (user spec). Delta damage (Fire, Harmony, Time) to one enemy in contact — the cast completes even with nobody in reach. On completion the caster holds Balefire as a temporary permanent (fixed power 6; falls at the end of the caster's NEXT turn, or to a Fire/Harmony/Time point-buy rolling 6) and draws 5 cards. While it stands every card in hand — basic actions included — is an instant: up to 9 bonus plans ride on each action (10 cards a round), yet only ONE element is emitted per action (general_ux_instants / Rule 20).

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Rule 21 (pc): Σ over the cast elements of max(caster stat − defender stat, 0), ÷10, rounded half up; a Force Shield die is subtracted from the Σ before rounding (peer side).
Cards drawn when the Balefire completes.
Bonus plans (instants) the holder may queue on each action while Balefire stands — every card is an instant then; still one element emission per action.
Turns the temporary permanent lasts: until the end of the caster's next turn.
Rule 24 threshold of the permanent: fixed 6 (no placement die).
Rule 24: an adjacent enemy emitting the matching stat destroys this permanent when their highest die is at least its power.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_fire (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.

note: nobody in reach — the cast still completes
